generations.operation: new key from selected sprite references
generations.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW useful production character visual key sheet based on the supplied SELECTED visual-novel sprite, not a replacement sprite. The reference image is the authoritative identity, childhood-stage, costume, paint style, and facial-construction reference. Remove its technical green backing in this new sheet. Large clean landscape sheet, ideally 2880x1920. Warm ivory/plain neutral studio backing, painterly realism matching the sprite, diffuse neutral daylight with softly warm highlights and enough fill to read eyes and skin. No orange wash. Carefully consistent same character in EVERY view.
Layout: upper row THREE complete full-body views FRONT, SIDE, BACK in relaxed standing pose with identical scale and visible feet; lower row SIX reasonably large head studies: neutral FRONT, attentive THREE-QUARTER, true PROFILE, gentle AMUSED, focused THINKING, subtly WORRIED. Labels may be these exact short English words; use readable unobtrusive dark type. No prose paragraphs, dimensions, invented ages or color swatches. Natural childhood anatomy, unchanged identity, eye aperture and normal embedded irises from reference; no enlarged doll eyes, no mini-adult, no teenager, no glamor makeup. Do not duplicate the same camera angle for front/side/back. Chest, nose, chin, ear and hair mass must rotate coherently. Same clothing construction, hair arrangement, skin color and head/body proportions across all views. Render fingers, toes hidden by shoes, clothing seams and straps credibly. No extra characters, extra limbs, props not in reference, scene backdrop, checkerboard, watermark or fanciful design additions. This is a character identity/structure reference, not a fashion redesign. Empty relaxed hands for structural views; if a handheld object appears in the source, show it once as a small faithfully matching separate prop inset, not in every hand or as new lore.
Title exactly: "CALISTA — EARLY CHILDHOOD". Preserve the selected young Cali's recognizable thoughtful, softly rounded face, light olive complexion, nose/cheek freckles, deep BLUE eyes, rich chestnut wavy/curly hair with the same loosely gathered crown and faded charcoal-teal bow. Preserve her cream rolled-sleeve blouse, worn brown-olive overalls, brown lace-up boots, and single brown sketchbook. Her hair is chestnut, not black; her complexion is olive, not Cassia's rich umber. She is still a young child, around the selected image's proportions, not a toddler. Mood palette is quiet curiosity, gentle amusement, concentration and slight concern. Do not introduce a dated temple injury/scar from her later-life biography.
